headline: As of 2026-09-25: 266,156 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 20 of 50 states, D+47.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 266,156 early/mail ballots cast so far across 20 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+47.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (147,630), New Jersey (46,692), Wisconsin (21,149).
